vetSays.line: 🛡️ Pablo, Sebastián, Jesse, Sam and Ruby met them at the door — 5 put down. Pablo, Sebastián, Jesse, Sam, Ruby are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sebastián just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sam just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Heidi, Sebastián, Jesse, Sam and Ruby met them at the door — 5 put down. Heidi, Sebastián, Jesse, Sam, Ruby are hurt.
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Beibit, Eman and Fiona met them at the door — 3 put down. Beibit, Eman, Fiona are hurt.

regDeaths.name: two knobs on glass-still water, watching
a toad like a war drum, throat swelling
the creek went still, and your arm-hairs stood up
